source:
# cop will not read these contents
group :development
group :development

origins.description: RuboCop::Cop::Bundler::DuplicatedGroup when investigating Ruby files does not register any offenses
RuboCop::Cop::Bundler::DuplicatedGroup when investigating Gemfiles and the file is empty does not register any offenses

source:
group :development do
  gem 'rubocop'
end
group :test do
  gem 'flog'
end

origins.description: RuboCop::Cop::Bundler::DuplicatedGroup when investigating Gemfiles and no duplicate groups are present does not register any offenses

source:

  gem 'rubocop'
end

  gem 'rubocop-rails'
end

diagnostics.message: Gem group `:development` already defined on line 1 of the Gemfile.

origins.description: RuboCop::Cop::Bundler::DuplicatedGroup when investigating Gemfiles and a group is duplicated registers an offense

source:

  gem 'rubocop'
end
group 'development' do
  gem 'rubocop-rails'
end

diagnostics.message: Gem group `'development'` already defined on line 1 of the Gemfile.

origins.description: RuboCop::Cop::Bundler::DuplicatedGroup when investigating Gemfiles and a group is duplicated using different argument types registers an offense

source:

  gem 'rubocop'
end
group :development, :test do
  gem 'rspec'
end
group :ci, :development do
  gem 'flog'
end
